proof_origin.place: Canonical-map construction and tensor comparison for the first equality of Tag 07N9

title: Explicit canonical completed localized tensor map
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings, with an R-algebra structure on S, and p a prime ideal of R. Put A=R_p, m the maximal ideal of A, C=AdicCompletion m A, B=A tensor_R S, and J=pB. The completion is the inverse limit of the quotients [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Construct the S-algebra map C tensor_R S → AdicCompletion J B as follows. The map A → B, a ↦ a tensor 1, sends m^n into J^n. Compose C → A/m^n with the resulting map to B/J^n and pass to compatible sequences to obtain C → AdicCompletion J B. Extend this map together with S → B → AdicCompletion J B by the tensor universal property. This construction is made without finiteness or Noetherianity assumptions.

proof.text: Use Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal and Ideal.map_map to identify the image of m with J. Ideal.map_pow gives all the power-containment conditions. Ideal.quotientMapₐ defines the coordinate maps. Their compatibility follows by quotient induction, together with AdicCompletion.Ideal.mk_eq_mk for Cauchy sequences. AdicCompletion.liftAlgHom gives the completed base map. AlgHom.liftEquiv followed by Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight extends it to the required S-algebra map. All of these constructions and proofs are written in Lean without holes.

mathlib_searches.query: canonical map of adic completions induced by algebra homomorphism preserving ideal powers
A ring homomorphism preserving ideals induces a homomorphism on adic completions
mathlib_searches.results: AdicCompletion.liftRingHom and AdicCompletion.map are building blocks, not this tensor algebra map.
Read AdicCompletion.Algebra and TensorProduct.Maps: liftAlgHom, quotientMapₐ, AlgHom.liftEquiv and commRight construct the map.

lean.statement:
def completionFiniteExtensionTensorMap
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] :
    let A := Localization.AtPrime p
    let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let B := A ⊗[R] S
    letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := R) (A := A) (B := S)
    let J := p.map (algebraMap R B)
    letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := R) (A := C) (B := S)
    (C ⊗[R] S) →ₐ[S] AdicCompletion J B
